name: Toga (Spain)
description: White field with three blue wavy stripes in the lower third, charged at the centre with a yellow two-arched bridge.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 26 January 2006 of the conseller de Justícia, Interior i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, on a ground of argent three waves of blue in the lower third and at the centre a bridge of or masoned sable, reflecting the position of the village on both banks of the river Millars (arms approved 19 December 2001).
